text: Entry Requirements (1) Non-Chinese citizens with a valid ordinary foreign passport (passport validity should exceed one year). (2) High school graduate or above (3) Generally between 18 and 60 years old. (4) Students must have a score of 180 in HSK 4 or above or equivalent to HSK4. Those who do not have a HSK 4 certificate can study in the Intensive Chinese Language Program and then apply for the Business Chinese Program after their Chinese proficiency meets the requirement.
